topic: Day 13 — carousel — Nobody's going to certify that now is the right time

slides.text: There's no authority who signs off on 'the right time.'
The waiting is the actual cost, not the timing.
Permission-seeking from someone who doesn't exist is just stalling.

caption:
There's no external authority who's going to certify that now is the right time. The waiting itself, not the timing, is the actual cost.
